competitions.name: Mathematics Challenge 2026 (ULM)
competitions.description: Open national math contest by HIMATIKA REAL FMIPA Universitas Lambung Mangkurat. Gelombang 3 registration open for SMA se-Indonesia (SMP track is Kalimantan-only). First-entry — no prior olympiad stage required.

competitions.name: MSI — Matematika, Sains & Bahasa Inggris (SMA Taruna Nusantara)
competitions.description: Open school competition (math, science, English) hosted by SMA Taruna Nusantara. Registration open from 1 August 2026 — first round is online; no national olympiad prerequisite.

competitions.name: LKIP — Lomba Karya Inovasi Pelajar (Karya Ilmiah)
competitions.description: Open research / scientific-work competition for SMP–SMA by SMA Taruna Nusantara. First submission window — no OSP/OSN medal required.

competitions.name: LKIP — Poster Competition (SMA Taruna Nusantara)
competitions.description: Open poster track under LKIP. Registration from 1 August 2026 — suitable for JH/SH creative STEM communication.

competitions.name: LKTIN APOTEMA 2026 (Karya Tulis Ilmiah SMA)
competitions.description: Open national scientific writing contest for SMA/MA/SMK by HMPS Tadris Matematika UIN SATU. Abstract registration closes 4 August 2026 — enter directly (pay only if abstract passes).

competitions.name: Anugerah Literasi ORBIT 2026
competitions.description: Free national writing contest (short story or opinion article) for SMP & SMA with Badan Bahasa / ORBIT Edutech. Open submission until 9 August 2026 — no prior competition required.

competitions.name: National Research Competition (NRC) 2026 — Essay track
competitions.description: Open national essay track for SMA/SMK & university students by UKM SMART Politeknik Negeri Lampung. Gelombang 1 closes 20 August 2026 — first-entry (no olympiad medal required).

competitions.name: National Research Competition (NRC) 2026 — Poster track
competitions.description: Open poster design track (pelajar / mahasiswa / general). Gelombang 2 runs 21 August–21 September 2026.

competitions.name: International Youth Math Challenge (IYMC) 2026 — Qualification
competitions.description: Open global online math challenge. Qualification round is free/direct entry (download problems + submit by 27 September 2026). Later rounds need a qualifying score — this listing is for the open first round only.

competitions.name: NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2026
competitions.description: Open global hackathon (software, data, storytelling). Registration opens 26 August 2026 — anyone can join a local or virtual event; no olympiad prerequisite.

competitions.name: Festival Film Indonesia 2026 — Pendaftaran Film
competitions.description: National film awards (Piala Citra). Submit cerita panjang, cerita pendek, dokumenter, or animasi produced/shown 1 Sep 2025–31 Aug 2026. Open to student and independent filmmakers — register at festivalfilm.id. Nominations 12 Oct; Malam Anugerah 20 Nov 2026.

competitions.name: Festival Film Indonesia 2026 — Kritik Film
competitions.description: FFI writing track for film criticism (not only production). Same 18 Jun–31 Aug 2026 window as film entries. Strong fit for students who watch widely and can argue in Indonesian.

competitions.name: Festival Film Dokumenter 2026 — Student Competition
competitions.description: Yogyakarta documentary festival student category for Indonesian SMP–SMA (and higher) directors. 2026 regular deadline was 27 July; festival 20–27 Nov. Watch FilmFreeway / ffd.or.id for the next cycle — fee waivers for Indonesian student entries.

competitions.name: Indonesian Students Movie Awards (ISMA) Vol. X
competitions.description: National student short-film festival (fiksi, dokumenter, animasi) by Yayasan Dian Didaktika. 2026 drew 186 films from 140 schools; awarding 24 Aug 2026. Watch isma.diandidaktika.sch.id for Vol. XI — this is the main pelajar film lane besides FFI.

competitions.name: Jogja-NETPAC Asian Film Festival 2026
competitions.description: Asian feature and short films (narrative, documentary, experimental, animation) produced after 1 Jan 2025. 2026 submissions closed 31 July; festival 28 Nov–5 Dec in Yogyakarta. Next cycle will open on FilmFreeway.

competitions.name: Minikino Film Week (Bali short films)
competitions.description: Bali-based international short film festival. Student and independent shorts routinely screen here — confirm the current FilmFreeway window on minikino.org before submitting.

competitions.name: Jakarta Film Week
competitions.description: Jakarta industry + public film week. Shorts and features from young Indonesian filmmakers; check jakartafilmweek.com / FilmFreeway for the open call of the current edition.

competitions.name: Sony World Photography Awards — Youth 2027
competitions.description: Free global photography contest for ages 19 and under. Enter up to three images (theme on the official site). Open 1 Jun 2026–5 Jan 2027, 16:00 GMT. Strong niche arts lane with London exhibition.

competitions.name: MILSET STEAM Photo Contest 2026
competitions.description: Science photography: explain a STEM phenomenon in a photo (ages 13–25). Up to three photos, English caption, no AI descriptions. Open 1 May–15 Oct 2026.

competitions.name: UNESCO Youth Eyes on the Silk Roads 2026
competitions.description: Photo contest ages 14–25, theme Living Heritage along the Silk Roads. 2026 closed 30 June; watch unesco.org for the next edition and camera prizes.

competitions.name: Breakthrough Junior Challenge 2026
competitions.description: Free global science-video contest (physics, life sciences, or math) for ages 13–18. ≤2-minute original video. Deadline 15 Sep 2026, 23:59 PDT. Peer review of 5 other videos required by 30 Sep for the $250k scholarship prize.

competitions.name: Conrad Challenge 2026–27 (Activation Stage)
competitions.description: STEM entrepreneurship: teams design an innovation that solves a real problem. Activation Stage 27 Aug–29 Oct 2026; Innovation Stage through 8 Jan 2027; Summit Apr 2027. Open first-entry for high-school teams.

competitions.name: Diamond Challenge 2027
competitions.description: Global high-school venture competition (business or social). Teams of 2–4 students aged 14–18 plus an adult advisor. Submission window opens 16 Sep 2026; deadline 14 Jan 2027, 17:00 EST. World Summit 29–30 Apr 2027.

competitions.name: World Robot Olympiad Indonesia 2026
competitions.description: National WRO qualifier: RoboMission, Future Innovators, Future Engineers, Entry Level. Registration is open on wroindonesia.org — confirm the exact national date on the official schedule before paying.

competitions.name: Bebras Indonesia Challenge 2026
competitions.description: Computational-thinking contest via school + Bebras Biro (not individual). 2025 ran in mid-November; watch bebras.or.id for the 2026 Bebras Week and biro list. Free, SMP and SMA tracks (Siaga / Penggalang / Penegak).

competitions.name: SEAMO 2026 (Southeast Asian Math Olympiad)
competitions.description: Open math olympiad K–Grade 12. Register at seamo-official.org by 18 Sep 2026, 23:55. Contest day 4 Oct 2026 (some countries 27 Sep — use the official portal for Indonesia).

competitions.name: SASMO 2026 (Singapore & Asian Schools Math Olympiad)
competitions.description: Grade K2–12 math olympiad via SIMCC. 2026 school window was Mar–Apr; results are out. Watch sasmo.sg / SIMCC for 2027 registration — a common first international math paper for SPI students.

competitions.name: Schematics ITS 2026 — National Programming Competition
competitions.description: ITS Schematics NPC: competitive programming, CTF, and data science tracks for SMP/SMA and university. Registration listed through 20–21 Sep 2026. First-entry friendly compared with OSN Informatika.

competitions.name: COMPFEST 18 — Junior Competitive Programming
competitions.description: Fasilkom UI COMPFEST JCPC for SD/SMP/SMA (individual). 2026 batches closed 18 July. Watch compfest.id for COMPFEST 19 — also Mini Case and other SMA-friendly tracks.

competitions.name: USA Computing Olympiad (open contests)
competitions.description: Free monthly-season programming olympiad anyone worldwide can sit (Bronze→Platinum). Create an account on usaco.org and enter the next contest window; no US residency required for taking the contest.

competitions.name: AMC 10 / 12 (MAA)
competitions.description: American Mathematics Competitions. International students register via a school or an approved testing center. AMC 10/12 A usually early November — confirm 2026 dates on maa.org. Qualifies toward AIME.

competitions.name: Math Kangaroo / IRK Indonesia
competitions.description: International Kangaroo-style multiple-choice math. Indonesia runs through local Kangaroo / IRK organisers — typically March contest after a winter registration window. Watch the current national host site before paying.

competitions.name: Coolest Projects (Raspberry Pi Foundation)
competitions.description: Showcase (not a cut-throat olympiad): students share any digital or hardware project. Annual global celebration; check coolestprojects.org for the next submission window. Excellent first-entry CS portfolio piece.

competitions.name: F1 in Schools
competitions.description: Design, make, and race a miniature F1 car as a school team (CAD, physics, branding, project management). Indonesia has a national programme — ask the school STEM club and f1inschools.com for the current season.

competitions.name: International Young Inventors Award (IYIA)
competitions.description: Indonesian-hosted international invention fair for students. Confirm the 2026/2027 handbook on iyia.or.id — a common next step after OPSI or school science fairs.

competitions.name: GENIUS Olympiad 2027
competitions.description: Rochester-area international high-school olympiad: science, invention, art, music, creative writing, business, robotics, short film — all themed on environment. Typical application deadline 1 March. Strong niche arts+STEM combo.

competitions.name: Regeneron ISEF (via affiliated fair)
competitions.description: World's largest pre-college science fair. Indonesian students reach ISEF through an affiliated national fair (not a random online form). Use OPSI / IYIA / school fair as the feeder; societyforscience.org lists affiliates.

competitions.name: Technovation Girls 2026
competitions.description: Girls and nonbinary students ages 8–18 build a mobile app + pitch. 2025–26 submissions closed 20 Apr 2026; World Summit Oct 2026. Sign up on technovationchallenge.org for the 2026–27 season (usually opens August).

competitions.name: VOCENTIC 2026 — Business Case & Poster
competitions.description: National vocational / business-case and digital-poster contest. Gelombang 2 listed through 1 Sep 2026 (early bird already closed). Confirm tracks and fees on the current committee page before paying.

competitions.name: Lomba Esai Nasional Universitas Terbuka 2026
competitions.description: National essay for SMA/SMK/MA on waste and sustainability. 2026 closed 31 July; winners 4 Sep with UT scholarships for top three. Watch lombaesai.ut.ac.id for the next edition.

competitions.name: Queen's Commonwealth Writing Competition 2026
competitions.description: Free Commonwealth writing prize (≤1000 words) for ages 18 and under. Theme 2026: Common Ground — Better Together. Closed 30 Apr 2026; Indonesia is eligible. Watch royalcwsociety.org for 2027.

competitions.name: John Locke Institute Global Essay Prize 2026
competitions.description: Essay prize (economics, history, IR, law, philosophy, politics, psychology, public policy, science & technology, theology). Under 19. 2026 submissions closed 31 May (late June). Watch johnlockeinstitute.com for 2027.

competitions.name: Foyle Young Poets of the Year
competitions.description: Free international poetry prize for ages 11–17 from The Poetry Society. Typical window spring–31 July. Confirm the live deadline on foyleyoungpoets.org before sending poems.

competitions.name: NYT Learning Network — My Tiny Memoir 2026
competitions.description: 100-word personal memoir contest for teenagers (NYT Learning Network). Open 16 Sep–28 Oct 2026. Later 2026–27 contests include a visual-arts round (28 Oct–9 Dec) — see the student contest calendar.

competitions.name: NYT Learning Network — Grow Up in 2026 (Visual Art)
competitions.description: New 2026–27 NYT student visual-arts contest: What It’s Like to Grow Up in 2026. Window 28 Oct–9 Dec 2026. International teenagers eligible via the Learning Network rules.

competitions.name: HIPPO English Olympiad 2026
competitions.description: School-based English olympiad (preliminary → national → continental → world finals). 2026 Asia-Pacific national finals 8–9 May; world finals Spoleto/Assisi 28 Sep–1 Oct. Register through the school coordinator at hippo-thecontest.org.

competitions.name: World Scholar's Cup — Jakarta Round 2026
competitions.description: Debate, writing, and scholar's bowl. Jakarta round 2–4 May 2026 (GMIS & Ciputra Artpreneur). 2026 school registration closed early March. Watch scholarscup.org for the next Indonesia round and Global Round.

competitions.name: Global Millennial MUN Yogyakarta 2026
competitions.description: Large MUN in Yogyakarta (junior / senior / open). 2026 conference 2–4 Jan at Royal Ambarrukmo. Watch gmmun.com for the next city — a niche diplomacy lane beyond LDI.

competitions.name: TED-Ed Student Talks
competitions.description: School club programme: students write and film an idea talk with a TED-Ed club advisor. Not a one-shot olympiad — start a club at ed.ted.com/student_talks. Strong speaking portfolio for SPI.

competitions.name: Future Problem Solving Program International
competitions.description: Creative problem-solving (global issues, writing, community projects) with regional affiliates. Schools register a team through fpspi.org. Niche alternative to olympiads for students who like scenarios and policy.

competitions.name: MONACO #11 — Moehi National Competition
competitions.description: SMA Muhammadiyah 1 Yogyakarta national multi-event (sains, foto, pidato, esai, poster, puisi, e-sport, and more). 2026 registration 19 Jun–3 Aug; event 19–22 Aug. Watch linktr.ee/MONACOSMAMUHI for #12.

competitions.name: KreaVIBE 2026 — Poster & Essay
competitions.description: National online poster + essay (SMA and university) on digital health and humanitarian themes. 2026 closed 7 Aug (works 5–10 Aug). Search the next KSR / PMI campus edition if you missed it.

competitions.name: AKSARA NUSANTARA 2026 — Essay SMA
competitions.description: National essay (SMA/SMK and university tracks) on sustainable technology. Batch 1 listed 17–31 July 2026. Confirm the organising campus page before the next batch.

competitions.name: MYRES — Malaysian Young Researchers / Indonesia feeder fairs
competitions.description: Regional student research expos (MYRES and sister IYSA fairs) that Indonesian SMA teams often use after school LKTI. Confirm the live handbook on the current IYSA/MYRES site before paying travel.

competitions.name: TOKI / TLX competitive programming
competitions.description: Indonesian olympiad-informatics practice arena (TOKI). Not a single deadline — create an account, grind, then sit OSN Informatika via school. The real niche CS ladder besides COMPFEST/Schematics.
